label: High fear premium
note: Option buyers pay far more than recent swings justify: historically followed by above-average market returns over 2–4 months, with larger swings. VIX above VIX3M: the term structure is inverted, a sign of near-term stress.
method: VRP = VIX² − 22-day realised variance of the S&P 500 (annualised %²); score = 10 × its percentile over the last 5 years. Bollerslev, Tauchen & Zhou (2009); Bollerslev, Marrone, Xu & Zhou (2014).
